Pizza date with my love
Oct 2024 • Couples
We came here to have a dinner with my partner. We ordered tuna pizza, garlic bread, sprite and passion fruit drink. 

About the foods; Garlic bread doesn’t taste like garlic at all.. it taste like some other herbs that I didn’t recognize.. I give bread 2/5, it wasn’t bad, but I would not order it again (price 70k VND). Tuna pizza doesn’t look so good.. the tuna was very moist and pizza was “swimming” in all the sauces. Pizza would be better if they have draine tuna before adding it. We give pizza 3,5/5. (Pizza price 190K VND). 

Drinks was great! 5/5 would recommend. 

(We add Tabasco to pizza and garlic bread that they taste better.)

Staff; waitresses speak good English and have smiles on their face. 5/5!
